capabilities: show daily, weekly, monthly and yearly notes on a month, week, day or agenda calendar
display, toggle and reschedule dated tasks by dragging chips between days
read Google Calendar events read-only and create meeting notes from them
register a month calendar view for Bases queries
fill periodic-note templates with agenda and week-digest tokens
extras: Google Calendar integration is read-only and needs a self-configured Google Cloud OAuth client; tokens stay in Obsidian secret storage, and mobile shows no events unless connected via the desktop sign-in flow. Some UI strings in the README are in Italian. The plugin ignores stale Periodic Notes config and Templater syntax is passed through unexecuted.
intentEvidence: Replaces the community Calendar plugin — disable it manually to avoid two sidebar calendars
problem: Daily and periodic notes, dated tasks, and external calendar events are scattered across separate views in Obsidian, with no unified calendar tying them to their dates.
